name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families. Benefit amount, exclusions and current payment status must be checked on the official portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop-insurance programme for notified crops and areas, subject to the current season notification, enrolment window and scheme rules.
states: all India; participation and notified crops vary

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
summary: Bank-linked credit facility for eligible farmers' cultivation and related agricultural needs. The bank determines documentation and sanction under applicable rules.

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
summary: Electronic agricultural trading platform connecting participating mandis and market participants. Local mandi participation and registration requirements apply.

name: Soil Health Card
summary: Government programme providing soil-test-based information to help farmers make informed nutrient-management decisions. Ask the local agriculture department or soil-testing lab for current availability.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
summary: Umbrella irrigation programme; component availability, subsidy terms and application windows depend on the current component and state implementation.
states: India; component and state implementation vary

name: PM-KUSUM
summary: Programme supporting specified solar-energy applications in agriculture. Component, eligibility, subsidy and application windows are state- and tender-dependent; verify current notices.
states: India; implementation and application windows vary by state

name: myScheme Government Scheme Finder
summary: Official Government of India portal to discover schemes and review eligibility and application details using user-provided profile information.
